name: PLUG POWER INC
description:
## Business Overview
Plug Power, Inc. provides an integrated **hydrogen and fuel cell** platform spanning **PEM electrolyzers (GenEco)**, **liquid hydrogen supply**, **fuel cell systems (e.g., GenDrive for material handling)**, and **hydrogen fueling infrastructure**, sold primarily to large enterprise customers. Revenue is generated through a mix of **equipment/system sales** and **recurring hydrogen fuel and services** tied to deployed sites.

## Market Position
Plug positions itself as a vertically integrated provider across hydrogen production and distribution plus on-site fueling and fuel cell deployments, and it has disclosed deployments of **70,000+ fuel cell systems** and **250+ fueling stations**. Key differentiators are ecosystem breadth (molecule + equipment + services) and operational experience running hydrogen-fueled sites at enterprise scale.
